evidence.quote: Participants must have documented unresectable and/or metastatic disease on CT or MRI imaging completed prior to registration.
Participants must have disease progression or intolerance to frontline standard of care (SOC) chemotherapy plus either nivolumab, pembrolizumab or any other PD-1 or PD-L1 inhibitor.
Participants must have a histologically confirmed diagnosis of microsatellite stable (MSS) and HER2 negative gastric, gastroesophageal junction, or esophageal adenocarcinoma

labels.note: Second-line advanced HER2-negative GEA after chemo-immunotherapy; she has resectable disease on curative CROSS.
